text:
maria: Heads-up — we're getting a lot of requests from EU managers asking for more time to finish reviewer writeups. Can we do a 48h slide for the calibration window for EU folks only?
alex: what's the impact on downstream handoffs? payroll/titles/comp rollouts?
jamal: payroll comp cycles are locked but final calibration doesn't feed payroll until Monday. 48h should be fine if we don't touch comp exports.
maria: ok good point. I want to avoid re-running comp packs. proposal: extend reviewer submission deadline for EU orgs by 48h, keep manager handback schedule the same, and run a small reconciliation pass before comp export.
sam: curious — how many reviewers will opt in? we might need backup reviewers for >10% spike.
maria: rough counts: EU reviewer load up ~14% higher this week because of PTO. so yes, could hit that threshold.
jamal: i can shift two EMs to cover overflow for 48h. they'll take reviewer backlog and flag any late-form questions.
people-ops-bot: FYI — forms lock/unlock can be scheduled via /forms-scheduler. Current unlock window set to 2026-03-24T09:00Z - 2026-03-27T18:00Z.
alex: can we automate unlocking only for people with location=EU and reviewers assigned region=EU?
maria: yes — engops has a tag mapping. i'll coordinate with engops to add the filter. (cc @alex)
jamal: also recommend we publish a short note to EU folks explaining exceptions + where to ask for help. Sample blurb below:
```
Heads-up — due to higher PTO coverage in EU, People Ops has opened a 48-hour reviewer extension window for EU-based teams only. If you need extra time, please continue your reviewer writeups; managers should still complete handbacks on schedule. For exceptions or questions, drop into People Ops office hours or DM maria.
```
sam: drop-in times? i can host Friday 14:00-15:00 CET and Monday 08:00-09:00 CET.
maria: perfect. i'll add calendar invites and update the review portal banner.
alex: double-check that reviewer overload routing is documented: who to ping when reviewer >10 pending reviews?
jamal: my EM rotation list covers that; i'll paste into the docs after this thread.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: publish announcement in #people-ops and ping EU leads at 2138765600.
maria: ok final checklist before I post: 1) confirm forms scheduler filter for EU only (alex) 2) assign overflow reviewers (jamal) 3) schedule drop-in office hours (sam) 4) update review portal banner & announce (maria)
alex: i'm on 1) — will finish in next hour.
jamal: 2) done — added EM cover and slack backup channel.
sam: 3) added invites.
maria: posting announcement now. will monitor replies for exceptions. thanks all :pray:
alex: thanks — keeping comp exports untouched is priority.
people-ops-bot: Announcement posted in #people-ops at 2138765565 by maria.
maria: closing thread — ping me if any late surprises.
